name: Blades rushed caller adaptation

chat_history.message: I'm in a rush—what time do you close on Friday?

success_condition: The agent answers immediately that Blades closes at 7pm on Friday in one concise sentence, without forced small talk, requesting personal details or changing the subject.

success_examples.response: Of course—we close at seven this evening.

failure_examples.response: Hello! How are you, and may I take your full name and mobile first?
